info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Consumer Decisioning API
info.description: The Consumer Decisioning API enables businesses to make informed decisions regarding their customers by submitting consumer data for evaluation. This API allows users to input customer information, such as demographic details and preferences, facilitating data-driven decision making. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions, retail companies, and marketing firms seeking to analyze customer behavior and tailor their services accordingly. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance customer experiences and optimize their strategies.
